bootstrap_alpha.label: Bootstrap alpha prior
bootstrap_alpha.help: Bootstrap alpha prior (before `MoM` estimation is available). Default: `2.0`.

fused_p_ceiling.label: Ceiling for the fused probability output
fused_p_ceiling.help: Ceiling for the fused probability output. Default: `0.995`.

fused_p_floor.label: Floor for the fused probability output
fused_p_floor.help: Floor for the fused probability output. Default: `0.80`.

fusion_prior_strength.label: Prior strength n₀ for the dynamic fusion weight w
fusion_prior_strength.help: Prior strength `n₀` for the dynamic fusion weight `w(n) = n / (n + n₀)`. Higher values give more weight to the calibrator (slower adaptation to real-time signals). Default: `20`.

min_sample_size.label: Minimum sample size before a bucket's resolution rate is trusted
min_sample_size.help: Minimum sample size before a bucket's resolution rate is trusted. Below this threshold the fallback chain is activated. Default: `30`.

refresh_interval_secs.label: How often
refresh_interval_secs.help: How often (seconds) the background updater reconciles calibration data from the DB and oracles. Default: `3600`.

max_capacity.label: Maximum number of tracked markets
max_capacity.help: Maximum number of tracked markets. Caution: capacity changes only apply to detectors constructed after activation (the live tracker keeps its capacity to preserve accumulated convergence durations). Default: `10000`.

max_idle_secs.label: Max idle time before a market's convergence state is evicted
max_idle_secs.help: Max idle time before a market's convergence state is evicted (seconds). Default: `7200`.

base_cooldown_secs.label: Base cooldown duration in seconds
base_cooldown_secs.help: Base cooldown duration in seconds. Default: `30`.

max_capacity.label: Maximum cache capacity
max_capacity.help: Maximum cache capacity (number of tracked markets). Caution: changing this at runtime rebuilds the cache, clearing all in-flight cooldown state. Default: `4096`.

max_multiplier.label: Maximum exponential backoff multiplier for consecutive emissions
max_multiplier.help: Maximum exponential backoff multiplier for consecutive emissions. Default: `16.0`.

base_fill_prob.label: Base fill probability for a single FOK order with fresh data
base_fill_prob.help: Base fill probability for a single FOK order with fresh data. Default: `0.90`.

depth_penalty_per_pct.label: Per-percentage-point penalty above the threshold
depth_penalty_per_pct.help: Per-percentage-point penalty above the threshold. Default: `0.02`.

depth_penalty_threshold_pct.label: Depth usage
depth_penalty_threshold_pct.help: Depth usage (%) above which fill probability drops. Default: `20`.

resolution_proximity_bonus.label: Bonus for near-resolution markets
resolution_proximity_bonus.help: Bonus for near-resolution markets (within 6 hours). Default: `0.05`.

high_threshold.label: Best-ask price at or above this value marks a market as converged
high_threshold.help: Best-ask price at or above this value marks a market as converged (YES or NO side). Money-critical: lowering it admits less-certain markets into the endgame funnel. Default: `0.95`.

max_investment_usd.label: Maximum USD walked into the order book per opportunity
max_investment_usd.help: Maximum USD walked into the order book per opportunity. Caps single-shot sizing before risk sizing applies. Default: `500`.

min_convergence_duration_secs.label: A market must hold convergence for at least this long before an opportunity may be emitted
min_convergence_duration_secs.help: A market must hold convergence for at least this long before an opportunity may be emitted. Guards against transient spikes. Default: `300` (5 minutes).

min_profit_per_share.label: Minimum profit per share
min_profit_per_share.help: Minimum profit per share (`1 - entry VWAP`) to act. Below this the edge cannot cover fees + slippage. Default: `0.005`.

category_weights.label: Per-category weight multipliers for scoring
category_weights.help: Per-category weight multipliers for scoring (lower fee categories are weighted higher). Categories absent from the map default to `1.0` at conversion time.

max_depth_usage_pct.label: Maximum depth usage
max_depth_usage_pct.help: Maximum depth usage (%) the detector may accept. Default: `50`.

min_score.label: Minimum composite score
min_score.help: Minimum composite score (0..1) to emit an opportunity. Default: `0.10`.

settlement_window_hours.label: Only markets settling within this many hours are scanned
settlement_window_hours.help: Only markets settling within this many hours are scanned. Larger windows admit slower-converging markets but tie up capital longer. Default: `24`.

min_profit_threshold_usd.label: Authoritative minimum net profit
min_profit_threshold_usd.help: Authoritative minimum net profit (USD) for detection, validation, and risk (single source per ADR-001 — never duplicated under `execution` or `risk`). Opportunities below this expected net profit are dropped. Default: `0.50`.

coalesce_window_ms.label: Max wait
coalesce_window_ms.help: Max wait (ms) for the second token leg before flushing a market scan. Lower = lower latency, more duplicate scans. Default: `40`.

dispatch_immediate_threshold.label: Scores at or above this bypass the funnel sweep delay
dispatch_immediate_threshold.help: Scores at or above this bypass the funnel sweep delay (immediate shard dispatch). Default: `0.5`.

max_book_to_order_ms.label: Max ms from last book apply to order emit
max_book_to_order_ms.help: Max ms from last book apply to order emit (SLO-2); older books fail validation. Default: `5`.

max_queue_size.label: Bounded priority-queue capacity; overflow evicts the lowest score
max_queue_size.help: Bounded priority-queue capacity; overflow evicts the lowest score. Default: `50`.

min_dispatch_interval_ms.label: Sweep interval
min_dispatch_interval_ms.help: Sweep interval (ms) between low-priority dispatches (high-score opportunities bypass via the fast lane). Default: `75`.

dispatcher_timeout_ms.label: Hard-kill timeout
dispatcher_timeout_ms.help: Hard-kill timeout (ms) for execution dispatch (FOK order round trip). Default: `30000`.

max_validation_slippage_bps.label: Max price slippage between detection and validation
max_validation_slippage_bps.help: Max price slippage between detection and validation (bps). Exceeding this rejects the trade. Default: `50`.

trade_confirm_poll_interval_secs.label: Interval
trade_confirm_poll_interval_secs.help: Interval (s) between confirmation polls. Read per relay poll — takes effect on the next cycle. Default: `2`.

trade_confirm_timeout_secs.label: Total time budget
trade_confirm_timeout_secs.help: Total time budget (s) to confirm a trade reached a terminal state. Read per relay poll — takes effect on the next cycle. Default: `60`.

enabled_categories.label: Categories admitted into the tradeable universe
enabled_categories.help: Categories admitted into the tradeable universe (WS subscriptions + scanner sweep). An event matches when any of its tag-derived categories is enabled. Empty list = every category. The full catalog is always ingested and persisted regardless of this filter — it only bounds the hot trading set, so narrowing it never loses settlement or evidence data. Default: empty (all categories).

staleness_acceptable_ms.label: Book age
staleness_acceptable_ms.help: Book age (ms) at or below which data is `Acceptable` (still tradeable). Default: `5000`.

staleness_expired_ms.label: Book age
staleness_expired_ms.help: Book age (ms) above `staleness_stale_ms` is `Expired` and ignored. This field documents the ladder's outer bound. Default: `30000`.

staleness_fresh_ms.label: Book age
staleness_fresh_ms.help: Book age (ms) at or below which data is `Fresh`. Default: `2000`.

staleness_stale_ms.label: Book age
staleness_stale_ms.help: Book age (ms) at or below which data is `Stale` (scored with discount, never traded). Default: `15000`.

alert_cooldown_secs.label: Minimum interval
alert_cooldown_secs.help: Minimum interval (seconds) between alerts with the same severity+title (anti-flood; applies to all channels). Default: `60`.

bot_token.label: Bot token
bot_token.help: Bot token (sensitive — masked in read APIs). Default: empty.

chat_id.label: Destination chat ID
chat_id.help: Destination chat ID (numeric, as a string). Default: empty.

enabled.label: Whether Telegram alerts are dispatched
enabled.help: Whether Telegram alerts are dispatched. Live-mode validation requires a non-empty `bot_token` and `chat_id` when enabled. Default: `false`.

enabled.label: Whether webhook alerts are dispatched
enabled.help: Whether webhook alerts are dispatched. Live-mode validation requires a non-empty `url` when enabled. Default: `false`.

url.label: POST target URL
url.help: POST target URL (sensitive — masked in read APIs). Default: empty.

api_error_rate_threshold.label: API error rate threshold
api_error_rate_threshold.help: API error rate threshold (0..1). Exceeding trips the L2 Session breaker. Default: `0.10`.

bankroll_usd.label: Total bankroll available for Kelly computation
bankroll_usd.help: Total bankroll available for Kelly computation (USD). Also seeds the simulated balance in `DryRun`/`Paper`. Default: `1000`.

base_cooldown_secs.label: Base adaptive cooldown after repeated misses
base_cooldown_secs.help: Base adaptive cooldown after repeated misses (seconds). Default: `900`.

half_open_probes.label: Successful probe trades required in HalfOpen before Recovered
half_open_probes.help: Successful probe trades required in `HalfOpen` before Recovered. Default: `2`.

l1_cooldown_secs.label: L1
l1_cooldown_secs.help: L1 (Trade): per-opportunity static filter failure cooldown (seconds). Default: `60`.

l2_cooldown_secs.label: L2
l2_cooldown_secs.help: L2 (Session): rolling window breach cooldown (seconds). Default: `900`.

l3_cooldown_secs.label: L3
l3_cooldown_secs.help: L3 (Daily): daily/weekly cap breach cooldown (seconds). Default: `3600`.

max_cooldown_secs.label: Maximum cooldown duration
max_cooldown_secs.help: Maximum cooldown duration (seconds) for L2 exponential back-off. Default: `14400`.

recovery_observation_secs.label: Observation period
recovery_observation_secs.help: Observation period (seconds) in Recovered before returning to Closed. Default: `300`.

cooldown_multiplier.label: Exponential multiplier applied per consecutive cooldown
cooldown_multiplier.help: Exponential multiplier applied per consecutive cooldown. Default: `2.0`.

daily_budget_usd.label: Independent daily spend budget
daily_budget_usd.help: Independent daily spend budget (USD). Execution stops when exhausted. Default: `50`.

daily_directional_budget.label: Daily budget of directional trades per side
daily_directional_budget.help: Daily budget of directional trades per side. Default: `10`.

drawdown_reduction_factor.label: Size reduction factor applied when the drawdown limit is hit
drawdown_reduction_factor.help: Size reduction factor applied when the drawdown limit is hit. Default: `0.5`.

max_drawdown_pct.label: Maximum drawdown
max_drawdown_pct.help: Maximum drawdown (%) before position sizes are reduced. Default: `10`.

heartbeat_max_failures.label: Consecutive heartbeat failures before an L4 System halt
heartbeat_max_failures.help: Consecutive heartbeat failures before an L4 System halt. Default: `3`.

max_kelly.label: Maximum Kelly fraction before capping
max_kelly.help: Maximum Kelly fraction before capping. Default: `0.25`.

max_probability_staleness_secs.label: Maximum staleness
max_probability_staleness_secs.help: Maximum staleness (seconds) of the calibration model before Kelly returns zero. Default: `7200`.

min_calibration_samples.label: Minimum historical sample count for calibration to be trusted
min_calibration_samples.help: Minimum historical sample count for calibration to be trusted. Default: `10`.

min_edge_bps.label: Minimum edge
min_edge_bps.help: Minimum edge (bps) below which Kelly returns zero. Default: `200`.

min_probability_confidence.label: Minimum calibration confidence
min_probability_confidence.help: Minimum calibration confidence (0..1) below which Kelly returns zero. Default: `0.3`.

market_miss_blacklist_count.label: Consecutive misses on one market before auto-blacklisting
market_miss_blacklist_count.help: Consecutive misses on one market before auto-blacklisting. Default: `3`.

max_concurrent_directional.label: Max concurrent positions on the same directional side
max_concurrent_directional.help: Max concurrent positions on the same directional side. Default: `3`.

max_consecutive_misses.label: Consecutive misses before the session breaker trips
max_consecutive_misses.help: Consecutive misses before the session breaker trips. Default: `3`.

max_cooldown_secs.label: Hard ceiling for the adaptive cooldown
max_cooldown_secs.help: Hard ceiling for the adaptive cooldown (seconds). Default: `7200`.

max_daily_fee_spend_usd.label: Daily fee-spend cap
max_daily_fee_spend_usd.help: Daily fee-spend cap (USD); breach halts at L3. Default: `25`.

max_daily_loss_usd.label: Daily realized-loss cap
max_daily_loss_usd.help: Daily realized-loss cap (USD); breach halts at L3. Default: `75`.

max_depth_usage_pct.label: Maximum fraction of visible book depth a single order may consume
max_depth_usage_pct.help: Maximum fraction of visible book depth a single order may consume (%). Default: `30`.

max_hourly_fee_spend_usd.label: Rolling hourly fee-spend cap
max_hourly_fee_spend_usd.help: Rolling hourly fee-spend cap (USD); breach trips the L2 breaker. Default: `10`.

max_hourly_loss_usd.label: Rolling hourly loss cap
max_hourly_loss_usd.help: Rolling hourly loss cap (USD); breach trips the L2 breaker. Default: `30`.

max_metrics_staleness_secs.label: Maximum age
max_metrics_staleness_secs.help: Maximum age (seconds) of the risk metrics snapshot allowed on the Live hot path. Must be >= `metrics_refresh_interval_secs`. Default: `15`.

max_single_bet_usd.label: Maximum USD for a single bet
max_single_bet_usd.help: Maximum USD for a single bet. Default: `25`.

max_single_loss_usd.label: Single-trade loss cap
max_single_loss_usd.help: Single-trade loss cap (USD); breach halts at L3. Default: `30`.

max_single_market_exposure_usd.label: Maximum exposure per market
max_single_market_exposure_usd.help: Maximum exposure per market (USD). Preflight rejects activation when set below any in-flight market exposure. Default: `500`.

max_total_exposure_pct.label: Maximum portfolio exposure as a percentage of available balance
max_total_exposure_pct.help: Maximum portfolio exposure as a percentage of available balance. Default: `80`.

max_total_exposure_usd.label: Maximum total exposure across all reservations
max_total_exposure_usd.help: Maximum total exposure across all reservations (USD). Preflight rejects activation when set below the currently reserved total. Default: `5000`.

max_weekly_loss_usd.label: Weekly realized-loss cap
max_weekly_loss_usd.help: Weekly realized-loss cap (USD); breach halts at L4. Default: `120`.

metrics_refresh_interval_secs.label: Interval
metrics_refresh_interval_secs.help: Interval (seconds) between CLOB balance + open-position metrics refreshes. Default: `5`.

min_balance_usd.label: Minimum CLOB collateral balance
min_balance_usd.help: Minimum CLOB collateral balance (USD); below this trading is gated. Default: `50`.

min_depth_usd.label: Minimum order-book depth
min_depth_usd.help: Minimum order-book depth (USD) required before execution. Default: `200`.

min_trade_usd.label: Minimum trade size
min_trade_usd.help: Minimum trade size (USD); sized below this the opportunity is skipped. Default: `1`.

permanent_blacklist_markets.label: Permanently blacklisted market condition IDs
permanent_blacklist_markets.help: Permanently blacklisted market condition IDs. Reload merges with — and never removes — entries added at runtime via the blacklist API. Default: empty.

permanent_blacklist_tokens.label: Permanently blacklisted CLOB token IDs
permanent_blacklist_tokens.help: Permanently blacklisted CLOB token IDs. Same merge semantics as `permanent_blacklist_markets`. Default: empty.

potential_loss_escalation_secs.label: Maximum age
potential_loss_escalation_secs.help: Maximum age (seconds) of an active potential-loss entry before escalation triggers an L4 System halt. Default: `3600`.

reconciliation_interval_secs.label: Interval
reconciliation_interval_secs.help: Interval (seconds) between ledger reconciliation runs. Default: `300`.

reconciliation_tolerance_usd.label: Maximum acceptable balance drift
reconciliation_tolerance_usd.help: Maximum acceptable balance drift (USD) before alerting. Default: `1.0`.

reservation_gc_interval_secs.label: Interval
reservation_gc_interval_secs.help: Interval (seconds) for cleaning expired in-flight reservations. Default: `30`.

reservation_ttl_secs.label: Default TTL
reservation_ttl_secs.help: Default TTL (seconds) for in-flight capital reservations. Default: `300`.

reserve_balance_usd.label: Balance reserve
reserve_balance_usd.help: Balance reserve (USD) excluded from the Kelly bankroll. Default: `100`.

ws_disconnect_threshold_secs.label: WS disconnect duration
ws_disconnect_threshold_secs.help: WS disconnect duration (seconds) before trading is gated. Default: `30`.

dedup_window_secs.label: Window
dedup_window_secs.help: Window (seconds) for deduplicating settlement triggers for the same market. Caution: shrinking it mid-flight admits duplicate triggers for markets settled within the old window. Default: `30`.

max_redeem_attempts.label: Maximum redeem attempts per position before terminal failure
max_redeem_attempts.help: Maximum redeem attempts per position before terminal failure (operator alert + manual intervention). Default: `5`.

retry_interval_secs.label: Interval
retry_interval_secs.help: Interval (seconds) between retry sweeps over failed settlements. Default: `60`.

all_sources_down_strategy.label: Behaviour when every oracle source is unavailable
all_sources_down_strategy.help: Behaviour when every oracle source is unavailable. Default: `conservative_reject` (fail-closed; never settle blind).

cross_check_delay_secs.label: Delay
cross_check_delay_secs.help: Delay (seconds) before the post-settlement cross-check re-queries sources. Default: `120`.

enabled.label: Whether the post-settlement oracle cross-check audit runs
enabled.help: Whether the post-settlement oracle cross-check audit runs. Disabling skips the audit only — settlement itself still requires a resolution verdict. Default: `true`.

voting_quorum.label: Sources that must agree before a resolution verdict is accepted
voting_quorum.help: Sources that must agree before a resolution verdict is accepted. Default: `2` (of Gamma / CTF / UMA).

gas_limit.label: Gas limit for redeem transactions
gas_limit.help: Gas limit for redeem transactions. Default: `500000`.

holder_address.label: Token holder address when it differs from the signer
holder_address.help: Token holder address when it differs from the signer (e.g. proxy wallet). `None` uses the signer address. Default: `None`.

output_asset.label: Output asset for adapter routes
output_asset.help: Output asset for adapter routes. Default: `usdc_e`.

proxy_safe_address.label: Gnosis Safe address for the proxy_safe route
proxy_safe_address.help: Gnosis Safe address for the `proxy_safe` route. Required by Live-mode validation when that route is selected. Default: `None`.

route.label: Active redemption route
route.help: Active redemption route. `disabled` blocks Live redemption (fail-closed: Live mode validation requires an explicit route). Default: `disabled`.
